_about: A220-300, built from the A220-100's measured outlines (bcs1/, the A220 ACP's A220-100 sheets, which are drawn to one scale) with the two fuselage plugs added back: plug.py on bcs1's snapped lines (side.snap.json, plan.snap.json; --ppm 89.404, --nose 102.5 side and 59.5 plan, --plug 9:2.16 --plug 21.84:1.554), the front view as it is. Pixels of the A220-100's rasters. Not traced on the A220-300's own sheets (Figure 1 sheets 1-2, page index 116-117): they're distorted along the body, not by one squeeze. They draw door 1 0.5 m aft and the aft door 1.0 m forward of the door-distance figure's 4.83 and 29.46 m (Figure 11, page index 141), so their door-to-door distance (23.1 m) is shorter than the A220-100's 20.9 m plus the 3.7 m of plugs between the doors, which the photos' 7 more windows confirm; and the engine inlet 1.05 m forward of the 12.17 m their own plan prints (K). Their overall figures (length, height, width, spans) agree with the A220-100's plus the plugs, so nothing of them is kept that this doesn't already give. The plugs are from the two types' printed door, exit, inlet and wing-tip distances. Doors and the overwing exit (not drawn) are placed from Figure 11 (distances to their forward edges; the exit 0.61 m wide as in the photos); cabin windows measured on Wikimedia Commons photos (the shape's sources).

windows.note: Measured on two side-on Wikimedia Commons photos of the left side (N337DU and YL-BTC, the shape's sources), scaled between the two doors' middles (from the door-distance figure): they agree within 0.10 m. 16 windows from 1.36 m behind door 1's middle at a 0.54 m pitch (the A220-100's 12 and the 2.16 m plug's 4), the exit's own window, two more 0.95 and 0.91 m apart, then 21 at about 0.533 m to 0.6 m ahead of the aft door; the 8 the wing hides in both photos placed at that pitch (the A220-100's 7 and one more, over the 1.55 m plug's three frames less the one YL-BTC shows). The band and width are the A220-100's: the same fuselage and windows.

sources.title: Airbus, A220 Aircraft Characteristics Publication (BD500-3AB48-13800-00, Issue 013-01, 2026-10-29), A220-300 Aircraft description: Figure 1 General aircraft dimensions; Figure 11 Door distance from nose
sources.note: The A220-300's general-dimensions sheets are distorted along the body (their doors up to 1 m from where Figure 11 puts them, the engine inlet 1.05 m forward of their own printed 12.17 m), so the outlines are the A220-100's (tools/trace/bcs1/, the same document's A220-100 sheets) with the 2.16 m and 1.55 m fuselage plugs added back; this sheet's printed figures are the checks. Doors and the overwing exit from Figure 11. No cabin windows drawn: they're from the photos below. Confidence medium: built by plugs, not traced on its own sheet.
